# Journal C1b

- 14:50 start: read brief, pages, ref tiles.
- 14:52 **worked well**: `npm create vite` + install tarballs + `npx @aziontech/webkit init -y` wired everything (webkit.css, icons, eslint, postcss/tailwind v4) in ~3 min. `webkit search` found a direct block for every page: `platform/view/split-view` (events explorer), `platform/view/table-view` (list), `platform/create/source-wizard` variant WhereItRuns (create step 1 — even the copy pattern "N more — type to narrow", "Continue without a …" matches). Excellent.
- 14:52 **low** — `init` added devDeps as `"latest"` (eslint, stylelint, husky...) and a `prepare: husky` script; reproducibility risk, not blocking.
- 14:52 **medium** — `platform/view/table-view` ships the page body only (no shell), while `split-view` ships its own full console shell inline (2844 lines, nav data duplicated) and `shells/console` ships the shell with a stand-in body. No documented way to compose "shell + table-view" except copying the shell and pasting the body in by hand. I copied `shells/console` ListPage into `src/shell/` and made it a slot-based layout component. ~10 min.
- 14:52 **medium** — block nav data is generic (Home/Projects/Resources/Services…, `pi` icons), not the Azion console nav (Applications, Functions, Edge DNS…). Had to map every Azion product to an icon myself; `@aziontech/icons` has product glyphs (`ai-edge-application`, `ai-edge-functions`, `ai-real-time-events`…) but no doc maps nav items → icons.
- 14:52 **low** — `@aziontech/icons/dist/azionicons-color.css` header comment says use `<i class="ai ai-google-cor">`, but the generated selectors are `.ai-cor.ai-google` (catalog agrees: `ai-cor ai-google`). Doc comment is wrong.
- 14:58 **high** — the husky pre-commit hook that `init` installs runs `eslint .` and fails on the **canonical block** `platform/view/split-view` as copied by `webkit add`: `vuejs-accessibility/label-has-for` (2 errors; the block uses `<label :for>` + `Checkbox :input-id`, which is valid a11y, but the rule's default requires nesting AND id). `<!-- eslint-disable-next-line -->` in the template is not honoured with the generated config. Fix: relaxed the rule to `required: { some: ['nesting','id'] }` in eslint.config.mjs. The generated `vite.config.ts` (from create-vite) also fails `webkit/authoring-standards` because it has a comment. ~10 min.
- 14:58 **high** — `npm run build` (`vue-tsc -b`) fails out of the box: every `@aziontech/webkit/<name>` import is TS2307 because the package `exports` point straight to `.vue` sources with no `types`; README "Requirements" claims `vue-tsc --noEmit` works under strict with `vueCompilerOptions.htmlAttributes` — added it, no change. Workaround: `src/env.d.ts` with `declare module '*.vue'` + `declare module '@aziontech/webkit/*'` (loses prop typing). Blocks themselves are plain JS `<script setup>` so a TS app gets no checking on them. ~10 min.
- 14:58 **medium** — authoring lint (`webkit/authoring-standards`) forces `interface Props`+`defineSlots` on my own layout wrapper, so the shell copied from the JS block had to be converted to `lang="ts"` and typed by hand (`Menu` `MenuNode`/`MenuSubKind` types not documented in `view menu`).
- 14:58 **low** — `table-view` block uses avatar photos from `ca.slack-edge.com` URLs (external network at runtime, and real people's photos in a sample). I used initials `Avatar`s instead; reference shows photos.
- 14:58 list page notes: reference toolbar is Filter button + search `Input` (as in `shells/console` stand-in body), but `table-view` block uses `PropertyFilter` → used the shell's stand-in toolbar + `useCollection.setFilteringText` (not documented in `view table`; found in use-collection source return list). Reference "Create Application" is outlined medium, block says primary large → followed the reference. Reference list has no header breadcrumb; shell guideline says one unlinked crumb → followed the reference (empty crumbs). `Table` stacks rows into cards below `--container-lg` by default; reference scrolls horizontally → `:stackable="false"`. **medium**: `Table.CellLink` has no leading-icon slot (GitHub / cube icons) and no non-link label mode; composed icon + CellLink in a flex span. `Button` has no link kind for the blue "Connect Git Repository" text button → used `Link :show-icon="false"`.
- 15:04 events page: `platform/view/split-view` is essentially the reference screen — after swapping nav data, sources (HTTP Requests / Functions / Firewall / WAF), hosts, the 14 event templates and `referenceNow = Date.now()`, the summary read exactly **Events 1,500 / Errors 325 / Avg 490 ms** and the page height matched (1614 vs 1636 px). **worked well**, ~15 min.
- 15:04 **medium** — `split-view` hard-codes `referenceNow = Date.UTC(2026,10,10,14,30)` and its own 200-line nav array and account copy ("alex", "alex@example.com") inline; the shell in this block is a second, hand-composed copy (no `AppLayout`) of `shells/console`, so the same nav lives in 3 places. I pointed both shells at one `src/shell/nav.ts`.
- 15:04 **low** — `Chart.Bar stacked` (5.12) draws a fixed GAP between stacked segments and leaves headroom above the tallest bar, so the histogram reads as thin striped bars; the reference shows solid stacked columns with axis labels at the exact start/middle/end. No prop for it (`chart-bar` props: ids, stacked, labeled). Left as is.
- 15:04 **medium** — `Table` defaults to `stackable` (rows turn into cards below `--container-lg`); split-view and table-view blocks leave it on, while the reference (and the shell guideline "tables scroll horizontally") wants horizontal scroll on iPhone. Set `:stackable="false"` in both pages.
- 15:04 create page: `source-wizard` WhereItRuns needed only copy/data swaps (Projects→Applications, service→workload, 25 workloads). **low**: picker rows are `Item size="small"` (~45 px, small text) vs the reference's 38 px rows with larger text; no Item size gives that. **low**: block copy rule says "Select, never Choose" and "no em dash", but the reference copy is "Choose a workload to continue" / "19 more — type to narrow." — followed the reference verbatim.
- 15:04 **medium** — the generated `eslint.config.mjs` and stylelint run over `dist/` (no ignores), so after `npm run build` the pre-commit hook fails on WebKit's own bundled CSS/JS (hex colours in Brand, literal ms timings, `0px`). Added `{ ignores: ['dist/**'] }` and `.stylelintignore`.
- 15:04 **low** — `webkit check` flags `declare module '@aziontech/webkit/*'` in a `.d.ts` as an unknown import (ERROR). Replaced the wildcard with one explicit `declare module` per used subpath. `check` also flags renamed block files (`webkit.blocks.json` paths) — fixed by editing the manifest by hand; no CLI command to re-point a block. Final `webkit check`: 0 errors, 1 warning ("latest" pins from init).
- 15:04 **low** — `webkit doctor` warns "no WebkitProvider in src/", but no block or the README Quick start wraps the app in it; added `<WebkitProvider locale="en">` in App.vue.
- 15:04 final: all three pages shot (desktop heights 1614/1136/900 vs ref 1636/1136/900), `npm run build` passes, `vite preview` serves every route and unknown paths with 200 (SPA fallback). Dev server stopped. Total ~75 min.

# DONE — job C1b (console)

## Pages
- `console-real-time-events`: built — from block `platform/view/split-view` (Azion nav, sources, hosts, 14 event templates, live timestamps; summary 1,500 / 325 / 490 ms). Gap: histogram bars render with segment gaps and headroom (Chart.Bar 5.12), not solid columns like the reference.
- `console-applications-list`: built — `shells/console` (as a slot layout `ConsoleShell`) + `platform/view/table-view` body with the shell's Filter + search toolbar. Gaps: Last Editor shows initials avatars, not photos (no external images); "Create Application" follows the reference (outlined), not the block (primary large).
- `console-application-create`: built — `platform/create/source-wizard` variant WhereItRuns (creation header, Stepper rail, workload chooser, "Step 1 of 4" on phone). Gap: picker rows ~45 px / small text vs reference 38 px / larger text (no Item size for it).

## WebKit pieces used most
Blocks `platform/view/split-view`, `platform/view/table-view`, `platform/create/source-wizard`, `shells/console`; components `AppLayout`, `Sidebar`, `Menu`, `GlobalHeader`, `SearchTrigger`, `Command`, `Brand`, `Avatar`, `Button`, `ButtonHighlight`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `Input`, `PageHeader`, `Card`, `TableRoot` + `Table.CellLink` / `CellTime` / `CellActions`, `StatusIndicator`, `Chart`, `Accordion`, `Checkbox`, `Chip`, `Badge`, `Stepper`, `Item`, `Breadcrumb`, `Link`, `WebkitProvider`; composable `useCollection`; theme layout classes and tokens; `@aziontech/icons` (`ai-*` product glyphs, `ai-cor` brand logos).

## Top 5 problems with WebKit (by impact)
1. `npm run build` (vue-tsc) fails out of the box: `@aziontech/webkit/<name>` exports point to `.vue` sources with no types, so every import is TS2307. The README's `vueCompilerOptions` fix does not help. Needed hand-written `declare module` shims, which lose prop typing.
2. The tooling `init` installs blocks itself. The husky pre-commit lint fails on the canonical `split-view` block (`label-has-for`), on create-vite's `vite.config.ts` comment, and on `dist/` (ESLint and stylelint have no ignores, so they lint WebKit's own bundled hex colours and timings).
3. No way to compose a shell with a page block. `table-view` has no shell, `split-view` carries its own copy of the shell inline (2,844 lines, nav duplicated), and `shells/console` has a stand-in body. I had to turn a block into a slot layout by hand. The nav sample data is generic, not the Azion console nav.
4. Block defaults differ from the console reference: `Table` stacks rows into cards on phone (reference scrolls sideways), table-view uses `PropertyFilter` (reference uses Filter + search), and the primary large create button and copy rules ("Select, never Choose", no em dash) conflict with the reference copy.
5. Some cell and chart features are missing: `Table.CellLink` has no leading-icon slot, `Button` has no link kind, `Chart.Bar stacked` cannot draw solid columns, and `Item` cannot give the 38 px picker row. Smaller doc errors: the icons colour CSS comment names the wrong class (`ai-google-cor` instead of `ai-cor ai-google`), and `webkit check` flags a wildcard `.d.ts` module as an unknown import.

## Build
`npm run build` passes (vue-tsc + vite build → `app/dist/`). `npx @aziontech/webkit check`: 0 errors, 1 warning (versions pinned to "latest" by `init`). ESLint and stylelint are clean. `vite preview` returned 200 for `/`, all three routes and an unknown path (SPA fallback). Router is in history mode with `/:pathMatch(.*)*` → `/`, so a static host also needs a rewrite to `index.html` for unknown paths.
